svg.title: Toolbox
svg.desc: Languages: JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, Java, Rust, HTML5, CSS3, Sass. Frontend: Vue.js, Quasar, React, Next.js, Tailwind, Three.js, Vite, Capacitor. Backend: Node.js, Flask, Django, SQLAlchemy, CF Workers. Data: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, Supabase, Firebase, Spark. Cloud & Ops: AWS, Docker, Nginx, Linux, Vercel, Actions. Tools: Git, GitHub, GitLab, VS Code, Figma, Android St., Vitest, Playwright
